newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt unit opens in Croatia.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt unit opens in Croatia.

text.p: Creditanstalt Investment Bank, a unit of Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein, said on Wednesday it had opened a subsidiary in Croatia, continuing the group's expansion in central and eastern Europe.

The subsidiary would concentrate on corporate finance and infrastructure project finance, the bank said in a statement released in Vienna. Plans to enter the securities business and asset management were in the pipeline, it added.
CAIB said its Zagreb subsidiary would oversee the expansion of the group in other parts of the former Yugoslav federation. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
